tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a URL as it is delivered: status, title, text and links, without running JavaScript. Works on every key. If `sparse` is true the page builds itself in the browser: use `see` instead.

tools.name: see
tools.description: Load a URL in a real browser and return a screenshot you can look at plus the rendered text. For a video URL, returns frames from it. Free keys get a monthly allowance: call `senses` to see what is left.

tools.name: hear
tools.description: Transcribe speech from an audio or video URL, up to 20 MB: full text, language and timed segments. Uses one perception per started minute of audio. Free keys get a monthly allowance of minutes.

tools.name: perceive
tools.description: Health check with an explanation: is it up, how fast, its security headers, and an excerpt of what it says. Paid keys also get sight, or hearing for media. Its `ok` covers those readings only and does NOT check any claim about the content: use `verify` for that.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Check a claim about a live page. `must_contain`, `must_not_contain` and `expect_status` are checked exactly. A free-text `expectation` is judged from the page's text on paid keys; on other keys, or when the text can't settle it (how a page looks, what a click does), the verdict is `unverified` and y

tools.name: drive
tools.description: Open a URL in a real browser, run up to 20 steps (60 seconds at most), and return what happened: a timeline, screenshots and the final text. This acts on the live site: clicks and form submits are real. Nothing persists between calls, and typed text is not logged. Steps: {do: goto|click|type|press|w

tools.name: senses
tools.description: What this key can use right now: its plan, which tools are open, and how many perceptions are left this month. Free to call.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check a claim about a live page. `must_contain`, `must_not_contain` and `expect_status` are checked exactly. A free-text `expectation` needs judgment: when Pentasor can't judge it, the verdict is `unverified` and you get the evidence (text, plus a screenshot on paid keys) to decide yourself. `pass` " → after: "Check a claim about a live page. `must_contain`, `must_not_contain` and `expect_status` are checked exactly. A free-text `expectation` is judged from the page's text on paid keys; on other keys, or when the text can't settle it (how a page looks, what a click does), the verdict is `unverified` and y"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
